about: Collaborators on repositories outside the SovereignWebsite organisation. Org apply's external-collaborators job adds each listed login with push (write) only; it never removes anyone, never lowers a role and never gives admin or maintain. Each grant must also be in policy/abp.json (pipeline external-collaborators, limits.grants), and the GitHub App must be installed on that repository with Administration read and write. A SovereignWebsite repository takes its collaborators from its request instead (requests/README.md).
